title: Multi-Generation Family with Baby on Porch, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait of a multi-generational family standing on the front porch steps of their home in the late 1940s. In the center, a woman lovingly cradles a swaddled newborn baby wrapped in a fringed blanket, flanked by a man dressed in a sharp double-breasted pinstripe suit and a young woman in a belted day dress. Standing prominently on the bottom step is a young boy squinting into the sunlight, outfitted in a tailored double-breasted winter coat and trousers. The image captures post-World War II family life and mid-century domestic pride.
